answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a proof-of-stake mechanism to resist Sybil attacks. Each agent must stake a unique, scarce digital asset, such as an ivory token, to participate. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities would need to acquire and lock a corresponding amount of tokens, creating a costly spiral of investment. As the network grows, a zephyr of validators verifies each transaction, making it economically infeasible for an attacker to maintain a large number of fake identities.
